description.narrative: Oxfam is publicly speaking out and campaigning on climate and inequality as a part of our overall inequality campaign. Oxfam is theleading agency bringing the two crises of inequality and climate together, with the expertise to speak out on both and on the intersection between the two crises. This flagship report aims to shift perception on the climate crisis. We will highlight the fact thatthe crisis exacerbates global inequality, and global inequality in return fuels the climate crisis. Neither one of them can be solved without addressing the other. This report will be instrumental not only in demonstrating the issues, but also illustrating that there are solutions that can and need to be implemented to pave the path to an equal, fair, and sustainable future. The report will also be important within Oxfam, to define and bring together Oxfam’s messaging on climate and inequality more clearly.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
